note: Task type → documents to read first. For tasks not listed, read AGENTS.md and start.

start.note: A new production starts by deciding purpose and direction with the user in BRIEF.md. Progress goes to STATE.md

local.note: Making things in the user's own ComfyUI: the map package (deno-comfyui-workflows) → once, comfyui-fit-my-pc to fix MY-PC.md → the workflow package and its attached files. Fetch packages with deno_knowhow_get into skills/

recipe.note: Follow the package's purpose and order; expression and pacing are the user's

review.note: Collect outputs in productions/<title>/renders/; the user judges them
